data.sql: SELECT commerce.inventory.product_id AS product_id, MAX(CASE WHEN commerce.inventory.snapshot_date = $1 THEN commerce.inventory.stock_on_hand END) AS stock_before, MAX(CASE WHEN commerce.inventory.snapshot_date = $2 THEN commerce.inventory.stock_on_hand END) AS stock_after, MAX(CASE WHEN commerce.inventory.snapshot_date = $3 THEN commerce.inventory.stock_on_hand END) - MAX(CASE WHEN commerce.inventory.snapshot_date = $4 THEN commerce.inventory.stock_on_hand END) AS stock_delta FROM commerce.inventory JOIN commerce.products ON inventory.product_id = products.product_id WHERE commerce.inventory.snapshot_date IN ($5, $6) GROUP BY commerce.inventory.product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT commerce.inventory.snapshot_date) = $7 ORDER BY commerce.inventory.product_id LIMIT 200

question: List the 20 products with the highest order_items.quantity sold during 2022, excluding cancelled orders.

data.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM commerce.order_items AS oi INNER JOIN commerce.orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id INNER JOIN commerce.products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= $1 AND o.order_date < $2 AND LOWER(o.order_status) NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY 3 DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 20

metadata.explanation: Joins order_items with orders and products to aggregate total quantity sold per product in 2022, excluding cancelled orders. Orders are filtered by date range and status. Results are sorted by total quantity descending, with product_id as a tie-breaker, limited to the top 20.
